fields.description: DAMAC Riverside Views is the apartment collection within DAMAC Riverside in Dubai Investments Park. Its named residential clusters sit around a planned waterway, with shared recreation, dining and wellness spaces. Original releases offered one- and two-bedroom homes; a separately documented Azure 2 release also includes studios.

overview: The landscape programme combines water-based recreation with outdoor exercise, gardens and gathering spaces. The apartment brochure describes a floating cinema, performance venues and places for waterfront dining. These form part of the planned community experience; confirm which facilities belong to the chosen building and when they will operate.
research.locationNote: The developer identifies Dubai Investments Park and road connections through the surrounding district. Confirm the actual building and access route: this apartment collection is distinct from the Riverside townhouses, and neither the project name nor a waterfront illustration establishes a natural river or a particular apartment outlook.
research.priceNote: The original fact sheet advertises one-bedroom homes from AED 888,000 and two bedrooms from AED 1,315,000; its numerical summary separately lists a lower AED 880,000 minimum. The Capri 1 sheet instead starts at AED 993,000 for one bedroom. Azure 2 includes a sampled studio at AED 628,000 and quotes an average studio price of AED 748,000. These are different document/release references, not a current stock list.
research.paymentNote: The stages below reproduce the Capri 1 launch schedule:20% deposit,50% through construction instalments and 30% at completion. The original factsheet shows the same structure. Azure 2's separate regular sheet starts with 10%, another 10% within two months, then a different instalment pattern. Obtain the actual unit's dated schedule before comparing deposits or monthly commitments.
research.handoverNote: The reviewed original, Capri 1 and Azure 2 sheets print an anticipated completion date of 31March2029. The headline uses Q1 2029 as a document-based estimate; this does not establish that every later release has the same contractual date.

facts.label: Original documented release
facts.value: The original fact sheet totals 2,523 homes across the building groups it lists. It is a release schedule, not a verified total for every future Riverside Views building or remaining inventory.

facts.label: Azure 2 scope difference
facts.value: The separate Azure 2 release sheet lists 720 studios and one-bedroom homes. The older factsheet instead lists 555 one/two-bedroom homes under Azure 2. Do not combine those totals without confirmation of the release and building codes.

facts.label: Document selection
facts.value: The plan pack labels its clusters and building variants. A floor-plan title alone does not establish a registered unit area or current availability.

unresolved: Confirm the exact named cluster, building and release, registered area, parking, finishing specification and service charges.
The fact-sheet area summaries omit explicit measurement units; their figures have not been silently converted to square feet or square metres.
Current availability, release-specific prices, instalment dates, fees and final contractual completion require developer confirmation.
